title: Miaomiao2 and Miaomiao1 new firmware support
symptom: Users are unable to use a L2 sensor with the modified app and want support for MM1 firmware 38 or MM2 with xDrip+.
evidence_quote: Is there a roadmap to support the new device and allow users failing to use a L2 sensor with the modified app to use MM1 firmware 38 (and future versions) or MM2 with xDrip+?
